key_insight: Bell--coherence fidelity estimation (BCFE) achieves optimal �984(1/�3b5) sample complexity for estimating the fidelity of arbitrary pure quantum resource states using only Clifford circuits and Pauli measurements.
engineering_relevance: BCFE offers a practical way to benchmark target quantum states without relying on non-Clifford operations, making it attractive for fault-tolerant and early-FTQC resource validation.
method: Decompose fidelity estimation into a Bell-measurement term and a coherence term.
Use only Clifford gates plus Pauli measurements to keep the protocol hardware-friendly.
Provide explicit control of the statistical error in the single-copy coherence contribution.
evidence_signal: In surface-code simulations for STAR analog rotation resource states, BCFE required up to about 27�d7 fewer resource states than DFE for the same standard error and stayed close to reference values under circuit-level noise.
watch_item: The added Bell-measurement operations introduce noise sensitivity, so real hardware performance will depend on how well those Clifford-layer measurements are implemented.
paper_title: Efficient Fidelity Estimation of General Quantum Resource States via Clifford Circuits
